decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core inkjet and ink expertise, so its in-house R&D can read early market feedback and refine it, making it a natural extension to retain.

The numbering software module builds on the firm's existing printing software and supports its strategic push toward serialization and traceability, so the firm can absorb and apply the related knowledge easily at low cost.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces uses the firm's broad ink chemistry and inkjet know-how, which lets it learn from early results and improve the product for demanding industrial applications.
